401.description: Authentication or project context was missing.

403.description: The API key lacks the required permission.

404.description: The requested session or event was not found.

409.description: The request conflicted with the current session state.

UpdateAgentParams.description: Fields to replace on an existing reusable agent.

compaction.description: Context compaction settings. Omit to keep the current settings. A supplied object replaces the settings; null or an empty object enables background compaction.

experimental.description: Experimental settings to merge by key. Omitted settings keep their current values.

instructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the agent's default base instructions. Omit to leave unchanged.

metadata.description: Replaces all metadata. Omit to leave unchanged, or pass null or {} to clear it. Up to 16 string key-value pairs, with keys up to 64 and values up to 512 characters.

model.description: The model to use for the agent. The requested model name is preserved.

multi_agent.description: Configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

name.description: A replacement name. Omit to leave unchanged, or pass null to clear it.

reasoning.description: Configuration for model reasoning. Omit to keep the current settings; pass `null` to reset to the model's default effort.

service_tier.description: The service tier used for model requests.

text.description: Configuration for text generated by the agent.

tools.description: Replaces the tool list. Omit to leave it unchanged, or pass null to clear it. The replacement must fit within 3 MiB (3,145,728 bytes) of compact UTF-8 JSON.

AgentResource.description: A reusable agent scoped to the caller's project.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the agent was created.

experimental.description: The effective experimental settings for the agent.

id.description: The ID of the reusable agent.

instructions.description: Custom instructions appended to the agent's default base instructions.

metadata.description: Custom string key-value pairs attached to the agent.

model.description: The requested model name used for inference.

multi_agent.description: The resolved configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

name.description: A human-readable name for the agent, or null if it is unnamed.

reasoning.description: The resolved reasoning configuration, including the model default for an omitted effort.

service_tier.description: The resolved service-tier policy used for model requests.

text.description: The resolved configuration for text generated by the agent.

updated_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the agent was last updated.

error.description: The error returned by the API.

CompactionParam.description: Settings for compacting the agent's context.

async.description: Whether to compact context in the background. Omission or null defaults to true. Set to false to use blocking compaction. Background compaction may increase token usage.

ExperimentalConfigOverridesParam.description: Experimental settings to update. Omitted settings keep their current values.

time_awareness.description: Whether to give the model periodic current-time reminders. Omit to keep the current setting.

MultiAgentConfigCurrentParam.description: Explicit configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

max_concurrent_subagents.description: Maximum number of subagents that may run concurrently. Defaults to 6.

effort.description: The amount of reasoning effort the model should use. Omission lets the model select it.

summary.description: Controls whether the response includes a reasoning summary.

ServiceTierParam.description: The service tier used for model requests.

TextParam.description: Configuration for text generated by the agent.

format.description: The output format. Omission uses ordinary text (`{"type": "text"}`).

verbosity.description: The amount of text the model should produce. Defaults to `medium`, matching Responses.

PersistedAgentToolConfigParamFunction.description: A function defined by the application.
